name: Tong Ming Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Tong Ming Enterprise Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells stainless steel fasteners and wires under the TONG brand name in China and internationally. It offers fasteners, such as screws, nuts, industrial rice, and threaded rods; and stainless-steel wires, which are used as customized raw materials for manufacturing small screws, kitchen supplies, mesh belts, re-stretching wires, and springs. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands.
